result.instructions: Tools for Parsio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my Parsio mailboxes and show how many documents each one parsed this week."; "Show the parsed data of my invoices mailbox for October."; "Which documents in my orders mailbox failed to parse?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Parsio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run parsio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run parsio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run parsio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. parsio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: parsio_list_mailboxes
tools.title: List mailboxes
tools.description: List all Parsio mailboxes (inboxes that hold documents and parsers) available to the account. Good first call to find a mailbox id. API: GET /mailboxes/.

tools.name: parsio_get_mailbox
tools.title: Get a mailbox
tools.description: Get one mailbox with its settings: name, parser type (preset), model and email address. API: GET /mailboxes/{id}.

tools.name: parsio_list_table_fields
tools.title: List table fields
tools.description: List the table fields defined in a mailbox (the column names of its parsed tables). API: GET /mailboxes/{id}/tableFields.

tools.name: parsio_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List documents in a mailbox, newest first, with status. Filter by date range, name search or status. Paginated (per_page max 500). API: GET /mailboxes/{id}/docs.

status.description: Only documents with these statuses (for example parsed, failed, skipped).

tools.name: parsio_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get a parsed document as JSON, with its status and extracted fields. Use it to fetch a result after parsing_in_progress was true. API: GET /docs/{id}.

tools.name: parsio_get_parsed_data
tools.title: Get parsed data
tools.description: Get the parsed data of documents in a mailbox, optionally for a date range. Paginated. API: GET /mailboxes/{id}/parsed.

tools.name: parsio_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the parsing templates of a template-based mailbox. Paginated. API: GET /mailboxes/{id}/templates.

tools.name: parsio_get_template
tools.title: Get a template
tools.description: Get one parsing template with its rules. API: GET /templates/{id}.

tools.name: parsio_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks of a mailbox (url, event, enabled). API: GET /webhooks/mb/{mailbox_id}.

tools.name: parsio_list_collected_emails
tools.title: List collected emails
tools.description: List the sender email addresses a mailbox collected. API: GET /mailboxes/{id}/emails.

tools.name: parsio_parse_text
tools.title: Parse text or HTML
tools.description: WRITE: create a new document in a mailbox from plain text or HTML and wait for the parsed result. It counts against the account's Parsio document quota. Works only for template-based and GPT-powered mailboxes. If it returns parsing_in_progress true, fetch the result later with parsio_get_document. API: POST /mailboxes/{id}/doc-sync.

text.description: Plain-text content. Send text or html. If both are set, Parsio uses html.

meta.description: Custom data that Parsio adds to the parsed JSON as __meta__.

tools.name: parsio_reparse_document
tools.title: Parse a document again
tools.description: WRITE: queue an existing document for parsing again, for example after you change a template. The old result is replaced. API: POST /docs/{id}/parse.

prompts.title: Get started with Parsio
